headline: Island Flips and Central Front Clashes Escalate Along Active Borders
war_summary: Since the previous edition, island combat has sharply escalated in Fisherman’s Row, where sixteen base transitions struck within the past two hours across contested positions including Eidolo and Dankana Post. Severe contact persists in Callahan’s Passage, logging eight recent strategic events and accelerating casualty rates as fighting churns around The Crumbling Passage and The Latch. Along the eastern sector, Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf sustain intense tactical turnover and heavy attrition, claiming thousands of casualties across Frostmarch, Wightwalk, and Breaker Town. In Linn of Mercy, Warden casualties continue to accelerate sharply despite a brief lull in recent base shifts, while Nevish Line registers fierce reciprocal bloodshed exceeding 2,500 casualties over two hours without new territorial transfers. Meanwhile, adjacent battlegrounds including Mooring County and Marban Hollow remain subdued following earlier clashes, leaving the operational focus squarely upon the western islands, central passes, and contested eastern borderlands.
